name: site
description: Website of a maschinenlesbar.org CLI: Jekyll, banira web components, Fylgja CSS

scripts.build:assets: npm run build:css && npm run build:js && npm run build:cli
scripts.test: banira test components/*.ts && banira lint components/*.ts --strict
scripts.build: npm run build:assets && bundle exec jekyll build
scripts.serve: npm run build:assets && bundle exec jekyll serve --livereload
